snippet.title: Nephelia: Through the clouds Gameplay Trailer 2025 (English)
snippet.description:
Hello! It is an immersive simulator of the airship captain "Nephelia: Through the clouds" and we've finally updated our trailer.

I wonder if it gives the right impression of a game, its vibe and mechanics. So please share your thoughts and guesses, it will be very helpful.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061140/
